page.layout: One text column at centre, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the first paragraph. The head line carries the page number at left and the running head at centre, with "LIB. III." at right. A partial neighbouring page is visible at the right edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Iuliano.temporis,et vbi olim ipse statuerat conditum fuit. Imo Iouianus eius successor, vtcunque Christianus (teste {r}Cuspiniano) mira cupiditate properabat (non prohibente hyemis sœuitia) Tharsam vrbem ad Iuliani tumulum exornandum inuisere, ciusque corpus (inquit Eutropius) qui cum Iouiani morte suam clausit Historiam, cum cunctas solemnia funeri eius exhibuisset, sepeliuit honorificè
main_text.head: CAP. IV.
De Christiana Orthodoxorum, præsertim vero Basilij Cognomento Magni obedientia erga Valentem Imperatorem Hæresi Arriana infectum.
main_text.p: Iuliano successit Iouianus; Iouiano Va-lentinianus vir bonus & principatu dignus, qui vbi ab exercitu Imperator es-[?]set renunciatus, insigniaque imperij accepisset eisdem militibus paulò post magna vociferatione conclamantibus ut alium quempiam Imperij consortem sibi ascisceret, in hunc modum res-[?]pondit

page.notes: Marginal note "Iuliano." stands at the left margin beside the first paragraph; its mark r is in the text after "teste". The initial I is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Iuliano". Doubtful: "es-set" and "res-pondit" line-break hyphenations, where the long s is hard to tell from f in the hyphenated syllable. The italic subtitle is partly roman and partly italic; italic runs are marked as they appear. The right-edge partial page is excluded.
